messages:
Priya: hey team, Priya here (first day!). I'm on Windows 11 with WSL2 Ubuntu. Running the dotfiles bootstrap but hitting permission errors when it tries to symlink into ~/.local/bin and fails to add asdf to my shell. Any Windows/WSL-specific tips?

chris: welcome! :wave: For WSL make sure you run the bootstrap from within the WSL shell, not Powershell. Avoid symlinking into /mnt/c paths. Also ensure your Ubuntu home is owned by your WSL user: `sudo chown -R $(whoami):$(whoami) $HOME`.

Priya: hmm I did run inside WSL. The script errors with "operation not permitted" on ln -s when creating ~/.local/bin/rdw.

emily: last time I saw that it was because Windows antivirus locked the folder. Try `lsattr ~/.local` and if immutable flag is set `chattr -i ~/.local`. Also check Windows Defender Controlled folder access.

Priya: good call, chattr was set. cleared it and bootstrap continues. Now asdf complains about python-build: needs libffi/openssl dev libs. How to install on WSL?

chris: `sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y build-essential libssl-dev libbz2-dev libreadline-dev libsqlite3-dev zlib1g-dev libffi-dev`. Then export build flags if needed. We prefer using system packages in WSL rather than brew equivalents.

Priya: thanks. Also trying to get poetry to use the asdf-managed Python. venvs are ending up under /mnt/c/Users which is slow.

emily: set poetry config `virtualenvs.path = "{cache-dir}/virtualenvs"` or `poetry config virtualenvs.in-project true` depending on preference. Make sure your project is inside the WSL filesystem (e.g., ~/projects) and not under /mnt/c. VS Code Remote-WSL helps keep files in the Linux FS.

Priya: VS Code remote warns about the devcontainer config referencing docker desktop. I use Docker Desktop WSL backend. devcontainer extension can't find docker socket. Any workaround?

devcontainers-bot: note: for Docker in WSL ensure Docker Desktop is running with WSL integration enabled for your distro. In WSL, `export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///var/run/docker.sock` usually works if the engine exposes the socket. Also check `sudo usermod -aG docker $(whoami)` and relogin.

emily: if you still see permission errors, try `sudo chown root:docker /var/run/docker.sock` then `chmod 660 /var/run/docker.sock` (but Docker Desktop normally manages this). Restart Docker Desktop after enabling WSL integration.

Priya: last thing: SSH agent forwarding in WSL for git pushes to GitHub. ssh-add on Windows agent vs WSL agent is confusing. Best practice?

chris: use the WSL-native ssh-agent: `eval $(ssh-agent -s)` then `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`. If you want to use Windows keys, there's `socat` bridge solutions but we recommend keeping keys in WSL. For GitHub, add the public key to your account.

infra-bot: created ticket ONB-703 for Priya. Please add your public SSH key to GitHub and confirm here so infra can grant repo access. Also joining the WSL office hours at 16:00 can help.

Priya: added key and joined office hours. Thanks everyone for the quick tips 44d
